annotations.title: utilpeek: cheapest cloud GPU per hour on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, on-demand and spot, by chip, memory and region

description: utilpeek: Cloud GPU prices: cheapest H100, A100, L4 per GPU-hour on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. Returns cheapest cloud GPU list prices per GPU-hour on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, on-demand and spot, by chip, GPU memory, region and price ceiling; optionally the month a purchase beats renting the cheapest row. Input: all optional: `chip`, `min_gpu_mem_gb`, `provider`, `regions`, `pricing`, `max_usd_per_gpu_hour`, `limit`, `rent_vs_buy`. List prices from a snapshot refreshed twice a day, excluding tax, egress and storage; spot changes often. A snapshot over 36 hours old is a 503 (not charged). Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/cloud-gpu-price-api.html

gpus.title: Gpus
